title: Pilot Gatekeeper Slate and Observability Quickmap (Mar 2026) - Draft
content:
Purpose and context:
This note is a compact operational primer for a small pilot rollout (pilot-gatekeeper) intended to validate routing/fallback behavior, latency guardrails, and prefix cache efficacy. It is light-weight — intended for the release steward, observability lead, and on-call SRE to run from preflight through 48h post-deploy.

High-level goals:
- Verify model routing fallback when dedicated capacity saturates
- Validate latency SLOs (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms) under 10% synthetic traffic
- Confirm KV prefix cache hit-rate >= 40% for the short sequence workloads
- Ensure graceful degrade path (auto-fallback to cheaper quantized variant) under sustained error rate

Quick calendar (pilot window) 
- 2026-03-18 08:00 UTC — Preflight telecon (15m) runbook review
- 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC — Dry-run deploy to staging (smoke)
- 2026-03-20 10:00 UTC — Micro-canary (1% traffic) for 60 minutes
- 2026-03-20 12:00 UTC — Gradual ramp to 10% over 90 minutes if no gate trips
- 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC — Stabilization watch (24h)
- 2026-03-22 10:00 UTC — Postmortem prep (collect artifacts)

Preflight checklist (must be green before any traffic shift)
- [ ] Infra: Dedicated GPU pool verified, nodes healthy, driver version 525.x confirmed
- [ ] Config: Gatekeeper routing policy applied (policy id: GK-2026-03), fallback model pinned
- [ ] Observability: Dashboards for latency, qps, error-rate, cache-hit ready and shared
- [ ] Alerts: Pager thresholds preloaded in OpsPager (see linked alert IDs)
- [ ] Tests: End-to-end smoke test passes on staging (automated run id: smoke-2026-03-19-02)
- [ ] Rollback: Rollback playbook validated and dry-executed in staging

Steward responsibilities (hour-by-hour for day-of)
- T-60 to T-15: Confirm preflight checklist, confirm pager duty coverage, announce on #deploys
- T-15: Acquire primary observability screen and run synthetic health probes (3 concurrent)
- T+0: Start micro-canary; watch p50/p95, error-rate, prefix cache hit rate 
- T+15: Confirm no alert noise and SLO headroom; document any noisy metrics in the logbook
- T+60: Decision point: move to ramp or roll back depending on gating criteria

Gating criteria (auto/manual gates)
- Abort (auto): sustained 5m error-rate > 2% or p95 > 450ms for 10 consecutive minutes
- Hold (manual review): cache-hit < 25% for 30m OR CPU/GPU saturation > 85% on any node
- Proceed: 0 critical alerts for 45m AND p95 < 350ms AND error-rate < 0.5%

Fallback matrix (fast mitigation steps)
- If errors spike: scale down traffic to 0% (auto) and trigger fallback to model-quantized-v2; notify on-call SRE
- If latency breaches: reduce batch size flag to 1 (fast toggle) and enable locality routing to nearest region
- If cache-win low: enable additional prefix caching layer and extend prefix TTL by +30s

Observability quickmap (dash & queries)
- Primary dashboard: /dashboards/pilot-gatekeeper-overview (shared link in Slack)
- Key queries (short form):
  - qps: sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route)
  - p95_latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
  - error_rate: sum(rate(requests_total{status!~"2.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[1m]))
  - cache_hit_ratio: (cache_hits_total / (cache_hits_total + cache_misses_total))

Notes on artifact collection (post-deploy)
- Collect: operator logs, model server tail logs, KV cache metrics, GPU telemetry, rollout controller events, linked GitHub PR and build artifact checksums
- Save snapshots: Prometheus 5m-interval snapshots for windows T-30m..T+120m and T+24h..T+26h
- Tagging convention: pilot-gk-<YYYYMMDD>-<step> (used for traces and traces export)

Draft release notes (to be cleaned for customer-facing release notes)
- Summary: Pilot rollout to validate intelligent routing policies and fallback variants. Small percentage traffic test to measure latency impact and cache benefit.
- Notable changes:
  - Introduced Gatekeeper routing policy that prefers lower-cost variants under mild congestion
  - Added prefix-level KV caching with instrumentation for hit-rate
  - Exposed per-route P95 histogram metrics to the dashboard
- User impact: No user-facing feature changes expected in pilot. If rollout completes, latency improvements on multi-turn short sequences expected.
- Ops notes: Rollout has an automatic fallback path to model-quantized-v2 and manual rollback ladder in the release steward playbook.
- Known issues (current):
  - Intermittent 429s observed in staging when batch size > 8 (mitigation: limit batch size in pilot)
  - Telemetry tag mismatch for region=eu-west in a subset of traces (investigating)

Communication plan
- Preflight: short announcement on #deploys with link to this doc and dashboard 30m before T0
- During: steward posts status every 30m as a threaded update on the deploy message
- Post: brief in #deploys + summary in weekly release digest; if rollback happened, escalate with Incident War Room (if >1h remediation)

Postmortem skeleton (to be completed after stabilization)
- Timeline: concise T-60..T+120 log with timestamps and decision points
- Root cause: (filled after RCA)
- What went well: guardrails that prevented user impact, quick rollback path, clear owner model
- Action items: owner, ETA, JIRA ticket id

Open questions / items for follow-up
- Decide on default prefix TTL for production: 20s vs 60s tradeoff (cost vs hit-rate)
- Confirm whether model-quantized-v2 satisfies quality bar for fallback in long-tail prompts
- Run scale tests for 1000rps synthetic load against gatekeeper routing to validate controller stability

Quick references and links (ops)
- Pager: @ops-sre (rotation)
- Slack: #deploys #pilot-gatekeeper #observability
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1987
- Jira epic: JIRA-REL-4823

Author notes:
- This is intentionally compact and meant to be used as a steward cheat-sheet. Expand to full runbook if pilot goes green and we move to broader canary lanes.
